title: No such things as selves exist in the world

statements.text: The central ontological claim: no such things as selves exist. For scientific and philosophical purposes the self as a theoretical entity can be eliminated. What has been called the self is not a substance, an unchangeable essence or a thing, but a special kind of representational content, the content of a self-model the system cannot recognize as a model.
